tool: read-only ZIP source/byte-line replay and five positive/tamper tests; original CI independently checked native binary/ELF and finite output behavior

definitions.prefix: static concatenated decoded byte strings through first retq, NOT dynamic execution or a complete function/ABI proof
definitions.region: all decoded bytes in a Wasmtime disassembly function region, including post-return padding/data
definitions.text: actual ELF .text section length; not inferred from prefix or region

inspection.observed_original_signmask_lowering: arithmetic shift plus RIP-relative literal-memory XOR of 0x8000000000000000
inspection.observed_add_signmask_lowering: arithmetic shift plus movabs 0x8000000000000000 and integer ADD
inspection.interpretation: ADD changes native code and lengthens the first-return prefix in three observed saturation functions; less post-return padding/literal region bytes do not produce smaller .text or .cwasm. SUB is a no-op in compiled AOT on both tested profiles.

evidence_limits: The archived ZIP and two source receipts were inspected in this run; only the earlier hosted CI executed patched Wasmtime and SMT.
Static first-return prefixes do not establish actual latency, throughput or power and do not cover all debug branch paths.
A QF_BV proof of pure value expressions is not VeriISLE verification of an installed rule, generic x86 machine-state correctness or poison/ABI flags.
Single pinned upstream and x86-64 architecture; not all targets or applications.
Human-proposed palette, not a proved optimal synthesized code sequence.
